head: 26efb1764ce1b502fe94e9cce429443363ed9d02

checks.note: existing build targets were up to date

findings.title: timeout 중 잘린 worker JSON이 전체 수집을 중단함
findings.evidence: trial._save_worker writes directly with Path.write_text; controller kills child on timeout. _read_trial failure branch json.loads every worker file without catching truncated JSON. Deterministic in-memory partial-worker reproducer raised JSONDecodeError. collect does not catch _execute failures per trial, so remaining matrix stops and manifest remains collecting.
findings.suggestion: worker JSON을 파일별로 읽고 decode 실패는 problems에 남겨 failed record로 반환한다. 원본 bytes는 보존하고 다음 조건을 계속한다. 잘린 worker evidence를 가진 timeout 회귀 검사를 추가한다.

findings.title: 계획의 DB/WAL 크기와 명시적 setup 시간 미기록
findings.evidence: returned trial record has cleanup_s and request resources, but no setup duration or DB/WAL file sizes; design metrics lists both.
findings.suggestion: 계획과 결과에서 미수집으로 한정하거나 정식 수집 전에 별도 필드를 기록한다.

structure_review: 1875 lines total includes tests. Four runtime modules (335,409,470,404 lines) separate adapters, trial, analysis and CLI. No concrete extra abstraction is needed for this fixed matrix.
limitations: No formal performance collection or profiling was run.
Only same-provider independent review was available; no Claude review claim.
Observed load average was high; test duration is not a performance result.
Partial-worker failure reproduced in memory against the actual _read_trial function; forced-kill timing was not exercised end to end.
Product src/python changes, commits, pushes and external comments were not made.
